TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Maintain hypertrophy adaptations during 2-week travel period"

PHASES
  PHASE "Travel Maintenance" (2 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Upper Body Push":
        warmup:
          jog_in_place 5m

          push_up 4x10..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds

          lateral_raise 3x15..20 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:

      DAY Tuesday training 40m "Lower Body":
        warmup:
          marching 5m

        cooldown:

      DAY Wednesday training 30m "Active Recovery":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:

          bird_dog 3x10 rpe 5 rest 45 seconds

          child_pose 3m
